infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: LUXE reads your step counts from the phone's motion sensor, only when you tap Import, so you can add them to your activity log.

plugins.cameraPermission: LUXE uses your camera to take progress photos, skin scan selfies, and photos of product labels.
plugins.photosPermission: LUXE uses your photo library so you can add progress photos and scan product labels.

plugins.contactsPermission: LUXE uses your contacts so you can invite friends to join the app.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: LUXE reads your steps, workouts, and sleep from Apple Health, only when you tap Sync, to add them to your private activity log.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: LUXE does not save or change anything in Apple Health. It only reads the data you choose to sync.
